 Home Depot Is Selling a Bunch of Milwaukee Tools Way Below Retail
 The retailer is running a series of promotions that cut prices and introduce unmissable BOGO deals.
 Gear Patrol 
 By Gray Van Dyke 
 Published November 4, 2026 
 ·
 Share 
 See more of our coverage in your search results 
 If you buy from a link, we may earn a commission. Learn more 
 November may have just started, but many stores are already rolling out deals as part of their annual Black Friday promotions. 
 Welcome to Shop Smarter : A series dedicated to highlighting not just what’s on sale, but why it’s worth owning. Discover more here . 
 Home Depot is among them, and it currently has a variety of incentives running across the Milwaukee portfolio . There are more than a few chances to walk away with big savings.
 For instance, the retailer is currently running straight discounts on a variety of power tools and accessories. From impact sockets and standalone kits to larger bundles, the range spans items and amounts.
 Among the biggest of which comes in the form of the M12/M18 ratchet and impact wrench combo. Spanning both systems and shipped ready to use with a dual-compatible charger, it’s an offering that’s marked down 40 percent from $499 to $299.
 Together with the other tool incentives, like the discounted M18 cordless oscillating multi-tool, it offers a great way to build out your bay for less.
 And that’s not even factoring in the other ongoing promotions that Home Depot is running for early Black Friday . The retailer also has BOGO deals where buying a qualifying battery kit or tool combo unlocks a free select power tool.
 That combination of outright discounts and free-tool offers makes this one of the stronger Milwaukee sales events of the year. Add in a few extra 5 percent off deals, and it makes for a strong opportunity to stock up on Milwaukee gear.
